result.brief: 提出几何监督的视觉表征学习框架 PureVision，通过理想空间分布约束解剖层级与表型关系，并用解剖引导的证据聚合提升医学 VLM 的病灶定位与表型刻画。
result.reason: Proposes geometry-supervised visual representation learning with latent-space structure for medical VLMs; representation contribution is plausible but abstract lacks detail on tokenizer/self-supervised video or world-model transfer.
